Hilbert: Hilbert-curve keys, grids and range decomposition. Consecutive Hilbert keys are always neighbouring cells, so sorting by a Hilbert key usually produces tighter row groups than Morton.
Morton (Z-order): Morton-curve (Z-order) keys, grids and range decomposition. Morton interleaves coordinate bits: cheaper to compute, with jumps at quadrant boundaries. The classic Z-order layout that Delta Lake popularized.
